description: TY2026: the OBBBA 1% corporate charitable floor. Gross income $2,000,000, ordinary deductions $1,000,000 -> base $1,000,000. Charity $100,000: capped at 10% (100,000) minus the NEW 1% floor (10,000) -> $90,000 deductible. Dividends $100,000 (20-80% owned): 65% DRD = 65,000, under the SS 246(b) cap (65% x 910,000). TI = 1,000,000 - 90,000 - 65,000 = 845,000 -> 21% = $177,450.00.
